verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a scheduling SaaS, but the pack documents no batch or bulk endpoints, MCP bulk tools, or UI multi-select actions. The REST API, MCP tools and webhooks act on individual resources. A developer could loop over single-item calls, but that is a building block, not the capability. Workflows automate per-meeting messages and do not perform bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
